method: NASA GFIT Kumaresan-Tufts direct impedance eduction

conditions.source_spl_reference: total SPL at the engaged-source-side liner edge
conditions.facility: NASA Langley Grazing Flow Impedance Tube

sample.construction: stereolithography chamber array with perforated facesheet and aluminum rigid backing

provenance.attribution: Quintino, Bonomo, Cordioli, Jones, Howerton, Nark, and Avallone (2025)
transformations: copied published dimensionless resistance and reactance without interpolation
retained the paper's common 500-2500 Hz comparison band
did not invent SI impedance or an unreported atmospheric normalization

applicability.reason: High-SPL perforated aircraft liner measured by grazing-duct impedance eduction; it is not representative of ordinary room finishes and is not a normal-incidence tube measurement.
applicability.local_reaction_note: The fitted normalized surface admittance may be exercised as a locally reacting validation boundary, but deployment requires matching sample construction, SPL, flow, and incidence assumptions.
